title: The Alapin (C3) Sicilian Defense | The Sensei Speedrun | Grandmaster Naroditsky

moves.spoken: The principled reply is the pawn to d5, striking the centre at once — one of the two main lines, and the move that keeps Black fully in the game.
moves.teaches: Meet the Alapin with the central break d5 before White completes the big centre.
moves.plans: Trade in the centre and develop the queen actively.

moves.spoken: The queen recaptures on d5 — centralised, but exposed. That early queen is the target White will develop against, gaining time with each piece that comes out.
moves.teaches: An early recapturing queen is active but vulnerable — its exposure hands the other side tempi.
moves.plans: Chase it with natural developing moves.

moves.spoken: White answers with the pawn to d4 — the standard Alapin tabiya. From here Black chooses between the knights to c6 or f6, and the c-pawn tension defines the middlegame.
moves.teaches: The exd5 Qxd5 d4 structure is the Alapin main battleground — small centre versus the c-pawn tension.
moves.plans: Develop with tempo and keep the tension.

moves.spoken: With the knight on c6 the tension between the c5- and c3-pawns sits unresolved — and usually Black should not release it, since capturing on d4 would open the c3-square for White's knight.
moves.teaches: Holding pawn tension is often better than releasing it into your opponent's development.
moves.plans: Keep the tension; develop and pressure the queen.

moves.spoken: The knight to d2 accepts that Black may take on f3 and damage the structure — but the plan comes first: reroute the knights and hit the exposed queen. The structural cost is worth the initiative.
moves.teaches: Sometimes a slight structural concession is the price of a faster, more active plan.
moves.plans: Follow with the bishop to c4, gaining time on the queen.

moves.spoken: The bishop to c4 strikes the queen, gaining a tempo and driving Black to react while White completes development and keeps the initiative.
moves.teaches: Develop with tempo against a centralised queen — every gained move compounds.
moves.plans: Chase the queen, castle, and press.
